source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && python3 -c "
import json, os, numpy as np

collapsed = [0, 3, 9, 15, 16, 18, 20, 22, 23, 24, 26, 27, 28, 30, 31, 32]

results = {}
for model in ['trained', 'untrained']:
    base = f'/root/autodl-tmp/vla-ssd/results/{model}/temporal_distance/'
    results[model] = {}
    for f in sorted(os.listdir(base)):
        if f.startswith('layer_') and f.endswith('.json'):
            layer = int(f.replace('layer_', '').replace('.json', ''))
            with open(os.path.join(base, f)) as fh:
                data = json.load(fh)
            results[model][layer] = data.get('per_task_mean_rho', data.get('rho', None))

# DINO
dino_base = '/root/autodl-tmp/vla-ssd/results/dinov2/temporal_distance/'
dino_rho = None
for f in os.listdir(dino_base):
    if f.startswith('layer_') and f.endswith('.json'):
        with open(os.path.join(dino_base, f)) as fh:
            data = json.load(fh)
        dino_rho = data.get('per_task_mean_rho', data.get('rho', None))

print('| Layer | Trained rho | Untrained rho | Delta_rho | Status |')
print('|-------|-------------|---------------|-----------|--------|')
for layer in range(33):
    t = results.get('trained', {}).get(layer, None)
    u = results.get('untrained', {}).get(layer, None)
    if t is not None and u is not None:
        delta = t - u
        status = 'COLLAPSED' if layer in collapsed else 'healthy'
        print(f'| {layer:2d}    | {t:.4f}      | {u:.4f}        | {delta:+.4f}   | {status} |')

print(f'\nDINO-V2 (layer 0): per_task_mean_rho = {dino_rho:.4f}')
print(f'Collapsed layers ({len(collapsed)}/33): {collapsed}')
print(f'Healthy layers ({33-len(collapsed)}/33): {sorted(set(range(33)) - set(collapsed))}')
" 2>&1
